name: videoweave
description: Control VideoWeave video editing from Claude — manage projects, upload clips, cut, join, add text, and produce final videos.
long_description: VideoWeave gives Claude 25 tools covering the full video editing workflow: create projects, upload clips, arrange a timeline, apply effects (cut, join, slow motion, speed up, text overlays, logos, audio), and produce a final output video. All processing runs server-side — no local software required beyond this extension.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your VideoWeave MCP API key. Generate one at VideoWeave → Settings → API Keys. Starts with vw_.

api_url.title: Server URL
api_url.description: VideoWeave MCP server URL. Leave blank to use the default production server.
